products.name: Classic American Flag
products.description: Premium quality 3x5 ft American flag made from durable polyester
products.longDescription: Our classic American flag is crafted from heavy-duty 200-denier polyester, designed to withstand the elements while maintaining vibrant colors. Features reinforced stitching on the fly end and a sturdy header with brass grommets for easy installation. Perfect for residential, commercial, or ceremonial use.

products.name: Betsy Ross Heritage Flag
products.longDescription: Honor American heritage with our authentic Betsy Ross pattern flag. Features the original 13-star design arranged in a circle as tradition dictates. Made from cotton for an authentic historical feel, this flag is perfect for historical reenactments, museums, or patriotic displays.

products.name: Thin Blue Line Flag
products.description: Support our law enforcement with this meaningful design
products.longDescription: Show your support for law enforcement with our Thin Blue Line flag. Features the iconic American flag design with a blue stripe representing police officers who serve and protect our communities. Made from weather-resistant nylon for indoor and outdoor display.

products.name: Gadsden Don't Tread On Me Flag
products.description: Historic revolutionary war era Don't Tread On Me flag
products.longDescription: Carry on the spirit of American independence with our Gadsden flag. Features the iconic coiled rattlesnake and 'Don't Tread On Me' motto. Printed on heavy canvas with brass grommets. A powerful symbol of freedom and personal liberty.

products.name: Liberty Tee - Navy
products.description: Premium cotton t-shirt with distressed American flag graphic
products.longDescription: Wear your patriotism with pride in our Liberty Tee. This premium cotton t-shirt features a beautifully distressed American flag graphic that gives it a worn, vintage feel. Pre-shrunk and garment-washed for ultimate comfort. Available in navy with white and red graphics.

products.name: Stars & Stripes Hoodie
products.description: Cozy pullover hoodie with American flag sleeve design
products.longDescription: Stay warm and patriotic with our Stars & Stripes Hoodie. Features a bold American flag design on the sleeves with a solid navy body. Made from a soft cotton-polyester blend with fleece lining for maximum comfort. Perfect for cool evenings and showing your American pride.

products.name: American Made Tank Top
products.description: Athletic fit tank top with vintage American Made text
products.longDescription: Show that you're American Made with our vintage-style tank top. Perfect for workouts or casual summer days. Features distressed 'American Made' typography with a small American flag. Lightweight, breathable fabric keeps you cool while showing your pride.

products.name: Founding Fathers Polo
products.description: Classic fit polo with subtle patriotic embroidery
products.longDescription: Look sharp and patriotic with our Founding Fathers Polo. Features subtle American flag embroidery on the chest and a classic fit that's perfect for work or casual wear. Made from premium pique cotton for breathability and style. A sophisticated way to show your American pride.

products.name: Freedom Cap
products.description: Adjustable baseball cap with embroidered flag
products.longDescription: Top off your patriotic look with our Freedom Cap. Features a 3D embroidered American flag on the front panel with 'USA' text. Adjustable snapback closure fits most head sizes. Made from premium cotton twill for durability and comfort.

products.name: Patriot Sunglasses
products.description: Aviator-style sunglasses with red, white, and blue lenses
products.longDescription: See the world through patriotic eyes with our Patriot Sunglasses. Features aviator-style frames with gradient lenses that shift from blue to white to red. UV400 protection keeps your eyes safe while you show your American spirit. Includes protective case.

products.name: Eagle Talon Belt
products.description: Genuine leather belt with eagle buckle
products.longDescription: Grab life by the talons with our Eagle Talon Belt. Features a stunning two-tone eagle claw buckle cast in zinc alloy with antique silver finish. Genuine leather strap in classic brown. A bold statement piece for the patriotic gentleman.

products.name: Liberty Keychain
products.description: Miniature Statue of Liberty replica keychain
products.longDescription: Carry the spirit of freedom with you wherever you go with our Liberty Keychain. Features a detailed miniature replica of the Statue of Liberty in antique copper finish. Solid metal construction with durable keyring. The perfect small token of American pride.
